claim.statement: The personal-agent task can be reopened with its goal, sources, pending work and current artifact digest; safe local updates preserve unrelated human edits and refuse stale writes.
claim.scope: Deterministic Craft service, Workbench HTTP projection, filesystem patch and task retry tests in the pinned Craft checkout.
limitations: These tests use local temporary workspaces and synthetic page responses; they do not prove live web or model accuracy.
UI installation, macOS restart, and real user benefit require separate runtime evidence.

cases.expected_behavior: After closing and reopening the local store, the Workbench task still exposes the original goal, page source locator, pending checkpoint and attention item, Task Run handle and current artifact version/digest. A Markdown patch changes only Beta, a stale file digest refuses after a human edit, and a fresh targeted patch preserves that edit.

argv: completed external work survives restart as unknown until its exact receipt is reconciled
cases.expected_behavior: An unlinked completion remains result_unknown after reopening, exact receipt reconciliation is idempotent, and the completed Host action is not retried.

argv: concurrent human edits are not overwritten between preview and apply|selected patches can be accepted independently and retried without overwriting human edits
cases.expected_behavior: Concurrent human changes are preserved; only selected non-conflicting entries are applied, and conflicts remain unaccepted.

argv: cumulative USD shrinks each attempt cap and exhaustion blocks new records before the retry-count limit|unknown cost stays reserved across attempts and explicit overrun accounting does not enlarge the total cap
cases.expected_behavior: Retries consume the existing total budget, unknown spend stays reserved, and approval or resume does not mint a fresh budget.
